# El Nuevo Mexico Restaurant

> Mexican Restaurant in Bastrop, Texas. Handmade plates, margaritas and house salsa, served by the Jaimes family on Childers Drive.

- Phone: (512) 321-1800
- Address: 201 Childers Dr., Bastrop, TX 78602
- Areas: Bastrop, Smithville, Cedar Creek, Webberville, Paige
- Offers: Mole enchiladas; Fajitas and carne; Margaritas and drinks
- Rating: 4.2 from 1247 Google reviews
